text: Hypothesis validated: the repair loop needs a regression-aware repair-base policy. In production run 20260827-203110, verification improved from 9 failed checks to 5 and then 2, but subsequent repairs regressed to 8 and 9 failed checks. The final repair also introduced a new deterministic Canvas runtime error by calling CanvasRenderingContext2D.ellipse with 6 instead of the required 7 arguments. The validated repair keeps the best evidenced failed candidate as the next repair base and prevents a worse or new-runtime-error candidate from replacing it. This candidate remains inactive and is not promoted as an active production lesson.
